title: Frontend health gate (react-doctor)
summary: Fails CI if the React app's react-doctor score drops below a threshold.
notes: react-doctor pinned to 0.5.6 (the flagship-vetted version; 0.5.x runs an oxlint-based engine and emits a flat schemaVersion-1 --json report parsed with jq). Run via `npx` (npm's resolver) rather than `pnpm dlx`, which pnpm 11 blocks as ERR_PNPM_TRUST_DOWNGRADE on a fresh resolve (a package-takeover defense). --no-telemetry disables the bundled Sentry client AND the aggregate 0-100 score (0.5.x derives the score from that path). So the gate is deterministic and error-severity-based: it fails on ANY error-severity finding; MIN_SCORE only applies if a numeric score is present (null under --no-telemetry) and a missing score is never coerced to 0.
